label: Orchid - Monitor and history
info: Receives device MQTT messages, displays the live feed, records availability and relay transitions, and alerts on stale telemetry or offline periods over five minutes.

name: Display feed and detect events
initialize: flow.set('orchidTelemetryAt', 0); flow.set('orchidOnline', 'unknown'); flow.set('orchidRelayState', null); flow.set('orchidStaleLogged', false); flow.set('orchidOfflineSince', 0); flow.set('orchidOfflineFiveMinuteLogged', false);

name: Offline >5 min and stale telemetry alerts

label: Orchid - Climate and light automation
info: Evaluates temperature, humidity, and light thresholds with hysteresis. Emits/logs events only; the ESP32 remains the sole owner of relay control.

name: Fan and light threshold rules
initialize: flow.set('orchidHighTemperature', false); flow.set('orchidHighHumidity', false); flow.set('orchidLightDemand', false);

label: Orchid - Water and mist rules
info: Detects low-water lockout/recovery and mist-demand conditions with hysteresis. This is monitor-only and never publishes actuator commands.

name: Water lockout and mist-demand rules

label: Orchid - Week 6 dashboard
info: Read-only monitoring dashboard for live telemetry, relay state, availability, and short sensor history. No control widgets or MQTT Out nodes.

name: Prepare live dashboard values
initialize: flow.set('orchidDashboardSnapshot', {temperature_c:null, humidity_pct:null, light_adc:null, water_adc:null, mist:'—', fan:'—', light:'—', mist_state:'—', mode:'—', availability:'unknown'}); flow.set('orchidDashboardTelemetryAt', 0);

label: Orchid - Week 7 business rules
info: Simulation-first, monitor-only business rules. They record recommendations and never publish MQTT actuator commands.

name: Read relay state for post-mist fan rule
Evaluate schedules and timers every 5 seconds
Daytime light schedule + dark-room guard
Recommend fan for 3 minutes after mist
